- **Due**: Week 2 (Friday, September 4)
- **Points**: Counts toward professionalism
- **Submit to**: Your client, CC your UCA
- **Submission**: By Individual

## Instructions

Send an introductory email to your client requesting your first meeting. CC
your UCA on this email and on every email you send your client for the rest of
the semester.
